legend.purpose: Silkscreened section legends and field labels, uppercase and widely tracked.

measure.purpose: Timecode, ruler labels, numeric fields; tabular numerals, measurement only.

shadows.name: ruler-rule
shadows.purpose: Hard 1px divider under the sticky ruler; not a lift.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Key and button background change, 120ms. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Transport Key
components.description: Raised square transport key with icon, legend and state lamp; pressed state flips the plate edge.
components.css: .ds-key{position:relative;display:grid;justify-items:center;align-content:center;gap:5px;min-width:84px;height:70px;padding:4px 14px 0;background:var(--panel-hi, oklch(0.31 0.015 250));color:var(--ink, oklch(0.93 0.012 85));border:1px solid var(--rule-strong, oklch(0.46 0.018 250));border-bottom-width:4px;border-radius:2px;font:600 10px var(--font-ui, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:background-color 120ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))}.ds-key::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;width:6px;height:6px;background:var(--lamp-off, oklch(0.34 0.012 250))}.ds-key[data-lamp=on]::before{background:var(--ink, oklch(0.93 0.012 85))}.ds-key[data-tone=live][data-lamp=on]::before{background:var(--signal, oklch(0.7 0.2 32))}.ds-key[data-tone=hold][data-lamp=on]::before{background:var(--amber, oklch(0.82 0.15 78))}.ds-key:hover:not(:disabled){background:oklch(0.35 0.016 250)}.ds-key[aria-pressed=true],.ds-key:active:not(:disabled){background:var(--panel-lo, oklch(0.2 0.013 250));border-top-width:4px;border-bottom-width:1px;padding-top:0;padding-bottom:3px}.ds-key:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.76 0.016 85));outline-offset:-1px}.ds-key:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-key{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Button
components.description: Raised neutral action with a strong rule border.
components.css: .ds-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:32px;padding:0 12px;background:var(--panel-hi, oklch(0.31 0.015 250));color:var(--ink, oklch(0.93 0.012 85));border:1px solid var(--rule-strong, oklch(0.46 0.018 250));border-radius:2px;font:600 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);transition:background-color 120ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))}.ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled){background:oklch(0.35 0.016 250)}.ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.76 0.016 85));outline-offset:-1px}.ds-btn:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid phosphor action with recessed-dark text.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:32px;padding:0 12px;background:var(--phosphor, oklch(0.87 0.17 128));color:var(--panel-lo, oklch(0.2 0.013 250));border:1px solid var(--phosphor, oklch(0.87 0.17 128));border-radius:2px;font:600 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);transition:background-color 120ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))}.ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:oklch(0.92 0.17 128)}.ds-btn-primary:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.76 0.016 85));outline-offset:-1px}.ds-btn-primary:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-primary{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Danger Button
components.description: Ink outline on a clear ground for destructive actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:32px;padding:0 12px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, oklch(0.93 0.012 85));border:1px solid var(--ink, oklch(0.93 0.012 85));border-radius:2px;font:600 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);transition:background-color 120ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))}.ds-btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled){background:oklch(0.35 0.016 250)}.ds-btn-danger:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.76 0.016 85));outline-offset:-1px}.ds-btn-danger:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-btn-danger{transition:none!important}}

components.name: Timecode Field
components.description: Screen-coloured numeric field with a strong rule border; monospace is reserved for measurement.
components.css: .ds-field{width:100%;height:32px;padding:0 8px;background:var(--screen, oklch(0.175 0.024 205));color:var(--ink, oklch(0.93 0.012 85));border:1px solid var(--rule-strong, oklch(0.46 0.018 250));border-radius:2px;font:13px/1.4 var(--font-measure,ui-monospace,'SF Mono',Consolas,monospace);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-field[aria-invalid=true]{border-color:var(--signal, oklch(0.7 0.2 32))}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.76 0.016 85));outline-offset:-1px}.ds-field:disabled{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}

components.name: Preferences Tab
components.description: Vertical preferences navigation: square lamp, recessed selection and bold readable text.
components.css: .ds-tab{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;height:34px;padding:0 14px 0 12px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.76 0.016 85));border:0;font:600 13px/1.4 var(--font-ui, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);text-align:left}.ds-tab>span::before{content:'';display:inline-block;width:6px;height:6px;margin-right:10px;vertical-align:1px;background:var(--lamp-off, oklch(0.34 0.012 250))}.ds-tab:hover:not([aria-disabled=true]){background:var(--panel-hi, oklch(0.31 0.015 250));color:var(--ink, oklch(0.93 0.012 85))}.ds-tab[aria-selected=true]{background:var(--panel-lo, oklch(0.2 0.013 250));color:var(--ink, oklch(0.93 0.012 85));font-weight:700}.ds-tab[aria-selected=true]>span::before{background:var(--phosphor, oklch(0.87 0.17 128))}.ds-tab[aria-disabled=true]{opacity:.45;cursor:not-allowed}.ds-tab:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.76 0.016 85));outline-offset:-1px}

components.name: Note
components.description: A note starts with an amber line and hatched text box; selection adds an ink outline.
components.html: Lights up
components.css: .ds-note{position:relative;width:240px;height:48px;border-left:1px solid var(--amber, oklch(0.82 0.15 78));color:var(--ink, oklch(0.93 0.012 85));font-family:var(--font-ui, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);cursor:grab;user-select:none}.ds-note-body{position:absolute;top:8px;left:0;max-width:260px;padding:2px 10px 2px 8px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;background-color:oklch(0.2 0.03 205);background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(135deg,color-mix(in oklch,var(--amber, oklch(0.82 0.15 78)) 22%,transparent) 0 2px,transparent 2px 6px);border:1px solid var(--amber-dim, oklch(0.58 0.11 78));border-left:0;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.35}.ds-note[data-selected=true] .ds-note-body{outline:2px solid var(--ink, oklch(0.93 0.012 85));outline-offset:1px}.ds-note:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.76 0.016 85));outline-offset:-1px}

components.name: Output Lamp
components.description: A square output lamp with printed name and state; the row opens its preferences page.
components.css: .ds-lamp-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:10px 4.4em 6em minmax(0,1fr);align-items:center;gap:12px;width:100%;padding:2px 6px;background:transparent;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:2px;font:13px/1.4 var(--font-ui, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif);color:var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.76 0.016 85));text-align:left;transition:background-color 120ms var(--ease, cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1))}.ds-lamp-row:hover{background:var(--panel-hi, oklch(0.31 0.015 250));border-color:var(--rule, oklch(0.36 0.015 250))}.ds-lamp{width:10px;height:10px;background:var(--lamp-off, oklch(0.34 0.012 250));border:1px solid var(--rule-strong, oklch(0.46 0.018 250))}.ds-lamp[data-state=on]{background:var(--phosphor, oklch(0.87 0.17 128));border-color:var(--phosphor, oklch(0.87 0.17 128))}.ds-lamp[data-state=fault]{background:var(--signal, oklch(0.7 0.2 32));border-color:var(--signal, oklch(0.7 0.2 32))}.ds-lamp-row b{letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--ink, oklch(0.93 0.012 85))}.ds-lamp-status{text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}.ds-lamp-row:focus-visible{outline:1px solid var(--ink-dim, oklch(0.76 0.016 85));outline-offset:-1px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-lamp-row{transition:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
The public name is **FLUX**, always uppercase. The modular F and the FLUX wordmark form the app's brand mark, with an 8px gap and 13px bold system lettering at 0.16em tracking. The launcher uses 22px lettering and a 12px gap. The symbol is decorative beside the readable name; an interactive mark keeps the translated About label. The existing instrument palette, controls and app icon are retained.

The app is an oscilloscope-style faceplate, not a dashboard. A matte charcoal-blue panel carries silkscreened legends, square engraved keys and small state lamps; set into it is a deep teal-black screen etched with a graticule, on which time is read off a ruler and clips and cues are drawn as phosphor and amber traces. The scene is a booth or a stage, so the system is dark by commitment: there is no light theme and none should be added.

Time comes first. The timecode is a 5x7 dot-matrix readout at the top left of the faceplate, transport keys sit in the centre, output lamps at the right. Below, a ruler over graticule lanes with track legends on the left, and an inspector on the right. It is Operate mode: dense, measurable, quiet until something is live.

The system refuses the web-dashboard card layout and the grey DAW slab. There is no glow and there are no rounded cards. State never rides on colour alone: kind, selection, mute and lamp state each carry a second cue (fill pattern, outline, dash, position, text).
keyCharacteristics: Two grounds only: faceplate (hue 250) and screen (hue 205); everything on the screen is read against the graticule.
Colour is signal: phosphor reads, amber cues and holds, vermilion means live or fault.
Squared forms, 2px control radius at most, 1px rules, lamps as squares.
Dot-matrix digits snapped to whole device pixels.
Layouts survive longer Spanish text (English default, Spanish shipped, no hard-coded strings).

rules.name: The Live-Only Vermilion Rule
rules.body: Vermilion appears only when something is live or faulted. The playhead is ink while stopped and turns vermilion only while playing.

rules.name: The Second Cue Rule
rules.body: No state is carried by colour alone: audio is a solid waveform and a note is a hatched box; selection is a 2px ink outline; mute is dashed and hollow with a struck name; lamps also print a status word.

rules.name: The Measurement Only Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for things you measure. Names, labels and prose are never monospace.

rules.name: The No Glow Rule
rules.body: Nothing glows, blurs or casts a soft shadow. Phosphor is a flat fill.

dos: Do keep the product dark-only; scene is booth or stage.
Do use phosphor for reading, amber for cues and hold, vermilion for live and fault only.
Do tell every kind and state apart by a second cue as well as colour (fill pattern, outline, dash, printed word).
Do keep corners square (2px at most) and rules at 1px, 2px for plate edges.
Do keep the dot-matrix cell on whole device pixels.
Do put every user-facing string through i18n (English and Spanish) and test layouts with the longer Spanish text.
Do keep monospace to measurement and tabular numerals on all time values.
Do keep the existing themed selection, caret, neutral focus line, scrollbars and reduced-motion handling on new surfaces.
donts: Don't use rounded cards, soft shadows, blur or glow.
Don't use vermilion for decoration, emphasis or warnings that are not live or fault.
Don't let colour alone carry kind, selection, mute or lamp state.
Don't set names, labels or prose in monospace.
Don't drift toward a dashboard card grid or a grey DAW slab.
